actions.description: What a preview or commit grant reaches, along the two axes enforcement checks separately: [modified] is the resources a transaction modifies directly, [pulled-in] the nodes its bundle pulls in.

capabilities.description: What a user or a token is allowed to do. [admin] and [users-manage] scope over tenants, [sudo] over user names. Every field is present: a capability that reaches nothing is written as a scope that allows nothing, not as an absent key.

reach.description: The tenants a grant reaches, each with the states it reaches there.

scope.description: A set of strings, as rules read longest match first: "a.*" allows every string starting with "a.", "!a.b" refuses "a.b", and the more specific rule decides. Order does not matter. An empty list allows nothing.

state-reach.description: The addresses reached in the states a rule names.

state.description: A state rule: a state id, or "*" for the states no other rule names.

tenant-reach.description: The states reached in the tenants a rule names.

tenant.description: A tenant rule: a tenant id, a prefix such as "prod-*", or "*".
